verdict.rationale: Bolt's first-party hosting docs say you can attach a custom domain you own or buy one through Bolt for a published app. A dedicated domains page also covers connecting an already-purchased domain to a Bolt project, on top of the default bolt.host address. missing for 10: in-depth evidence of the connection steps (DNS records, SSL provisioning, verification), independent or hands-on corroboration that custom domain connection works.
